summary: Full backend + frontend smoke test for ClipForge AI MVP. 12/12 backend pytest cases passing (auth register/login/google/me/logout, clip CRUD, export, mocked AI transcript/suggestions, protected route 401). Frontend: landing page renders with all sections (ClipForge, How it works, Features, Pricing, FAQ), login with seeded creator@clipforge.ai/Creator2026! works and redirects to /dashboard showing 3 seeded clip cards + stats, New clip navigates to /upload page (drag/drop UI), pricing page renders Free/Pro plans, protected /dashboard correctly redirects to /login when unauthenticated. Auth cookies set httpOnly via /api/auth/login (200).

ui_bugs.issue: Clip cards on dashboard do not navigate to /clip/:id when clicked (clicking the card stays on /dashboard). Only 'View all' link is interactive. Users likely expect each card to open the clip editor.

action_items: Make dashboard clip cards clickable -> navigate to /clip/:id (Link wrapper or onClick handler). Currently the 'New clip' button works but seeded clip cards are non-interactive in the test viewport.
Add data-testid attributes on login form (email-input, password-input, login-submit) and clip cards (clip-card-{id}) for more reliable automated testing.
Optional: consider secure=True for cookies in production env (currently secure=False hard-coded).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py logout requires authenticated user (Depends get_current_user) so calling /api/auth/logout without cookies returns 401 — acceptable but could be made idempotent.
CORS allow_origins is fine (uses FRONTEND_URL), but backend .env still has CORS_ORIGINS='*' which is unused; remove to avoid confusion.
set_auth_cookies hard-codes secure=False — should be True in production deployments.
/api/videos/{id}/stream accepts JWT via query param (?auth=) which can leak in logs; document or restrict.
Pydantic password min_length=6 is weak; consider 8+ with complexity for production.
test_credentials: creator@clipforge.ai / Creator2026! (works); admin@clipforge.ai / ClipForge2026! (seeded, not directly UI-tested)
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded user + 3 seeded clips. Test-created clips/users are prefixed TEST_ and cleaned up within the CRUD test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_clipforge.py covers all critical endpoints. Frontend login flow requires .get_by_role('button', name='Log in') (clicking generic submit selector failed silently in first attempt — submit selector wasn't matching). Dashboard clip cards are not clickable currently; if main agent wires up navigation, retest the full flow signup -> dashboard -> clip editor -> caption style change -> export.
